title: Stealing the Kissing Parlor's damsel
description: In a Kissing Parlor on level 2, the player asks for a kiss without the $10000 and is sent away. He picks the damsel up, priced at $30000, can't pay and puts her down, then picks her up again and walks out of the shop with her. The shopkeeper shouts "Come back here, thief!" and shoots him dead.
